I.value_zh: TASK-005 草稿、四层涌现观察、Bridgeflow 只读实证及 FCoP ADR/规则均只被引用；必须逐字吸收的七节点图和三句中英 Core Principle 原文未随本 TASK 提供。
I.value_en: The TASK-005 draft, four-layer observation, Bridgeflow evidence and FCoP ADR/rules are referenced; the seven-node diagram and three bilingual Core Principle sentences required verbatim are not supplied with this TASK.
I.notes_zh: 外部实证仅为引用，审定不读取 Bridgeflow。
I.notes_en: External evidence is referenced only; adjudication does not read Bridgeflow.

O.value_zh: working tree 中 Proposed 状态的 ADR-0034 v2 草稿，使用新的 internal/external document convention 文件名。
O.value_en: A Proposed-status ADR-0034 v2 draft in the working tree, using the new internal/external document convention filename.
O.notes_zh: REPORT、归档、commit、push 均被明确延后。
O.notes_en: REPORT, archive, commit and push are explicitly deferred.

A.value_zh: 撰写 ADR-0034 v2，纳入四层、词汇表、升级路径、反向吸收专节与严格原文图；删除未提交 v1 草稿并在 v2 引用中记录。
A.value_en: Write ADR-0034 v2 with four layers, vocabulary, upgrade path, reverse-absorption section and verbatim diagram; delete uncommitted v1 draft and record it in v2 references.

P.value_zh: ADMIN 作出升级定义与草稿指令；ME 起草；任何 sub-agent 继承 ME 身份。
P.value_en: ADMIN makes the upgrade definition and draft directive; ME drafts; any sub-agent inherits ME identity.
P.notes_zh: 不由身份推导写入或发布权限。
P.notes_en: No write or release authority inferred from identity.

R.value_zh: 原文没有执行时限、预算、容量或资源配额；P0/low 为优先级和风险自评，四层与七节点是内容结构，不是 R。
R.value_en: The source gives no execution deadline, budget, capacity or resource quota; P0/low are priority and self-assessed risk, while four layers and seven nodes describe content structure, not R.
R.notes_zh: 优先级不改变禁止边界。

V.value_en: Rules 0.a/0.a.1/0.c/1/5/8/9.3, ADR-0006, ADR-0017, ADR-0033 and SOP references.

C.value_zh: v2 草稿路径、Proposed 状态、四层、词汇、升级路径和 v1 废稿记录均明确；§2.5.6 要求逐字吸收七节点图及三句中英 Core Principle，但原文内容未给出，无法核对该部分完成。
C.value_en: The v2 path, Proposed status, four layers, vocabulary, upgrade path and v1 supersession record are specified; §2.5.6 requires verbatim use of a seven-node diagram and three bilingual Core Principle sentences whose text is absent, so that portion cannot be checked.
C.notes_zh: 完成条件不等于完成事实。
C.notes_en: Completion criteria are not completion facts.

B.value_zh: 不得修改规则四件套、src/fcop、模板、Bridgeflow；不得发布、commit、push、替 ADMIN 决定升级路径；不得改写已提交 TASK-005。
B.value_en: Do not modify four rule files, src/fcop, templates or Bridgeflow; do not release, commit, push, decide upgrade path for ADMIN, or rewrite committed TASK-005.
B.notes_zh: working tree v1 草稿删除是唯一例外。
B.notes_en: Deletion of uncommitted working-tree v1 draft is the only exception.
